pages.text: The first point costs 32 activity. Each earned point adds 64 to the next cost, capped at 4,096. Successful job actions earn activity; failed actions, idle time, and changing orders do not.
Successful deliveries and warehouse cargo collection normally earn four units per moved stack; fetching or ordinary cargo pickup by a carrier earns none. Healing and revival earn one unit on success.

Actual following or rider movement earns one unit per 100 ticks by default. Heralds earn the same while monitoring an active or blocked worker. Defensive hits or shield blocks have a one-second award limit.
